chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Brings a Souvenir from His Hallucination | Chapter 2
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang struggles to separate a brutal alchemy hallucination from his hospital reality. A visit from his girlfriend Yang Na offers warmth, but a chilling discovery blurs the line between the two worlds.
og_title: The Mortar That Crossed Worlds: Li Huowang's First Glimpse Behind the Veil
og_description: Li Huowang's girlfriend brings him homework and hope. Hours later, he tastes the remains of a nightmare—and finds it is real.
twitter_title: When a Hallucination Leaves a Physical Mark
twitter_description: Li Huowang's quiet hospital visit takes a terrifying turn when a piece of alchemical paste from his nightmare sticks to his skin.
